name: Landing Page URL → Complete Ad Set (Canvora)

parameters.content:
## Landing Page URL → Complete Ad Set (Canvora)

### How it works

Submit a product or landing page URL through the built-in form; Canvora reads the page and designs a complete ad set — square, landscape, and portrait — covering every major placement (Meta feed, Stories, display). The workflow polls until generation completes and delivers the finished ads to Slack, or posts a failure alert.

### Setup steps

- Create a free Canvora account at [canvora.ai](https://canvora.ai) — free credits included, no card required — and get an API key from canvora.ai → Integrations → API Keys (available on all plans).
- In every Canvora HTTP Request node, use one shared Header Auth credential: name `X-API-Key`, value your `vd_...` key.
- Connect Slack credentials and pick your review channel.
- Open the form URL from the trigger node and submit a page to test.

### Customization

- Add `og_image`, `blog_header`, or an `instagram_carousel` to the outputFormats list for a fuller promo kit (100+ formats: GET https://api.canvora.ai/api/formats).
- Pass a `brandId` (GET /api/brands) to lock ads to your brand kit's colors, fonts, and logo.
- Cost: 3 ads = 30 credits per run.
- Swap the form trigger for a webhook to fire this from your CMS or product catalog.

## Collect the URL

A built-in n8n form collects the landing page URL that the ad set will be designed from.

## Start Canvora generation

Sends the URL to the Canvora generation API requesting square, landscape, and portrait ad formats.

## Poll generation status

Waits between status checks, fetches the generation state, and loops until completion or timeout.

## Deliver the ad set

Sorts the finished ads and posts them to Slack with a review link.

## Send failure alert

Posts a Slack notification when generation fails or times out.
